title: 第3章 异界攻伐第4章 宗门恩泽处处在
content_zh:
转眼间三十日的期限已至。
江云涯把着楚墨的手腕，仔细检查过后，欣然地点点头，开口道：“想必早就炼气成功了？天赋倒是不错。”
楚墨平复下体内细小的真炁，面色苍白地回道：“全仰仗师兄指导。”
【角色信息】
玩家：楚墨
......
等级：1级
功法：《周天采气法》
......
由于王泉的无私奉献，楚墨早在二十日前便顺利迈入炼气一层，成功变成一名修仙者，玩家等级也升到1级。
而王泉等人死亡没有引起任何波澜，就像三人从未出现一样。他精心准备的解释也没用上。
李二黑小心翼翼地偷瞄楚墨。自从王泉三人消失后，他就怀疑是楚墨暗下杀手。吓得他吃不好睡不好，生怕哪天对自己下手。
可偏偏对方一直没有动作，那种死神将临未至的感觉，让他神经紧绷，差点疯掉。
今日再次见到江云涯才松懈下来，楚墨总不能在宗门师兄面前，出手打杀自己吧？
江云涯没有理会黑脸汉子的情绪，直接将手搭在对方腕上，片刻之后轻轻皱眉：“你没有突破？”
李二黑露出一抹羞愧之色，尴尬的挤出笑脸：“对不起江师兄，俺还差一点，再给俺几天时间，一定能突破。”
“不用了。”
江云涯摇摇头，屈指弹出一道白光，黑脸汉子头上瞬间多出个拇指大小的洞口，扑通一声倒在地上，笑容永远停留在脸上。
随后一缕灰色气体从尸体中升起，没等楚墨仔细观察，便化作一道灰光消失不见，他隐约中看到了那柄‘弟子名册’的影子。
“凡人躯体污浊，也就魂魄有些价值。”江云涯淡淡的说道。

“这就是魂魄？”楚墨喃喃道。
杀王泉与邵玲时没有看到魂魄，这似乎是他炼气后才有的特殊能力。
“师弟你很不错。”江云涯对楚墨十分满意，天赋好，度厄宗就需要这样的人材。
他衣袍轻抚，李二黑的尸身如烟尘般消散无踪，他转向楚墨，脸上带着浅淡的笑意，“随我来。”
楚墨沉默的跟在对方身后，离开了这间可能留下过大量血腥的院落。
门外是一条蜿蜒小径，晨曦洒在薄雾中，更显仙家气氛。
江云涯步履从容，边走边道：“宗门遴选，大浪淘沙。三十日内无法炼气者，天赋拙劣。
继续修炼也是浪费阳寿，不如早早改修魂道。有玄冥洞景幡在，也算是一番造化。
你的天赋不错，应潜心修炼，万不可自满松懈。”
楚墨连忙低声应道：“多谢师兄提点。”
不多时，前方雾气稍散，露出一片空地。那里已站着七八个人，有男有女，皆是与楚墨一同入门的弟子。
他们有的惊魂未定，隐含恐惧；有的冷漠戒备，打量来人；还有的带着一丝压不住的兴奋与倨傲。
见到江云涯到来，所有人立刻收敛神情，恭敬的垂手站立，无人敢出声。楚墨默默走到人群末尾，感受到几道眼神在他身上划过，又迅速移开。
江云涯扫过众人，微微颔首：“不错，随手招来的一批弟子，竟有九人过关。”
他从衣袖中取出一朵‘棉花’，朝空中一抛。‘棉花’迎风便长，化作一片巨大的祥云。
江云涯跃上灵云：“上来，带你们去藏书阁。”
众人不敢怠慢，立刻紧跟其上。楚墨脚下传来软绵绵的感触，像是踩在棉花上，微微用力又变得坚硬，有些奇妙。
灵云托着众人在诸多仙峰中穿梭，约莫一炷香后，落向一座掩映在一处古木之间的巨大楼阁。
这楼阁通体由一种暗沉色的灵木构建，飞檐斗角，气势恢宏。门楣上悬着一块硕大的牌匾，上书三个大字——藏经阁。
江云涯率先落下，灵云随之变小钻回袖中。他领着九名弟子走入大门，朝入口案几后面的老者叫道：
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, the thirty-day deadline has arrived.
Jiang Yunya held Chu Mo's wrist, inspected it carefully, nodded happily, and said, "I must have succeeded in refining Qi a long time ago? His talent is pretty good."
Chu Mo calmed down the small amount of zhenqi in his body and replied with a pale face: "It all depends on the guidance of senior brother."
【Character information】
Player: Chu Mo
...
Level: Level 1
Kung Fu: "Zhoutian Qi Collection Method"
...
Due to Wang Quan's selfless dedication, Chu Mo successfully entered the first level of Qi Refining twenty days ago, successfully became an immortal cultivator, and his player level also rose to level 1.
The death of Wang Quan and others did not cause any waves, just as if the three people had never appeared. His carefully prepared explanation was of no use.
Li Erhei cautiously glanced at Chu Mo. Ever since Wang Quan and the others disappeared, he suspected that Chu Mo was the assassin. He was so scared that he couldn't eat or sleep well, for fear that one day he would be attacked.
But the other party never made any move, and the feeling of imminent death made his nerves tense and he almost went crazy.
He relaxed after seeing Jiang Yunya again today. Chu Mo couldn't kill himself in front of his sect brothers, right?
Jiang Yunya ignored the dark-faced man's emotions and directly put his hand on the other man's wrist. After a moment, he frowned slightly: "You didn't make a breakthrough?"
Li Erhei showed a look of shame and smiled awkwardly: "I'm sorry, Senior Brother Jiang, I'm still a little bit behind. Give me a few more days and I will definitely be able to break through."
"No need."
Jiang Yunya shook his head and flicked out a white light with his finger. A hole the size of a thumb appeared on the black-faced man's head. He fell to the ground with a plop, and the smile stayed on his face forever.
Then a wisp of gray gas rose from the corpse. Before Chu Mo could take a closer look, it turned into a gray light and disappeared. He vaguely saw the shadow of the 'disciple list'.
"The mortal body is dirty, but the soul has some value." Jiang Yunya said lightly.
"Is this the soul?" Chu Mo murmured.
No souls were seen when he killed Wang Quan and Shao Ling. This seemed to be a special ability he gained after refining his Qi.
"Junior brother, you are very good." Jiang Yunya was very satisfied with Chu Mo. He has good talent. Due Sect needs such talents.
He stroked his robe gently, and Li Erhei's body disappeared like smoke and dust. He turned to Chu Mo with a faint smile on his face, "Follow me."
Chu Mo followed the other party silently and left the courtyard where a lot of blood might have been left.
Outside the door is a winding path, with the morning light shining in the mist, adding to the atmosphere of a fairy home.
Jiang Yunya walked calmly and said as he walked: "The selection of the sect is like a big wave. Those who cannot refine their Qi within thirty days have poor talent.
Continuing to practice is also a waste of life, so it is better to change to the soul cultivation path as soon as possible. The presence of the Xuanming Cave scenery flag can be regarded as a blessing.
Your talent is good, you should practice it with concentration, and don't be complacent and lax. "
Chu Mo quickly responded in a low voice: "Thank you, senior brother, for the tip."
Not long after, the fog dispersed slightly ahead, revealing an open space. There were already seven or eight people standing there, both men and women, all disciples who had started with Chu Mo.
Some of them were in shock, with implicit fear; some were indifferent and alert, sizing up the visitors; and some showed a trace of uncontrollable excitement and arrogance.
Seeing Jiang Yunya's arrival, everyone immediately calmed down and stood respectfully with their hands down, no one dared to say anything. Chu Mo silently walked to the end of the crowd and felt a few eyes pass over him and then quickly move away.
Jiang Yunya glanced at the crowd and nodded slightly: "Yes, of the group of disciples I recruited, nine of them passed the test."
He took out a piece of cotton from his sleeve and threw it into the air. 'Cotton' grows in the wind and turns into a huge auspicious cloud.
Jiang Yunya jumped up to Lingyun: "Come up and take you to the library."
Everyone did not dare to neglect and immediately followed him. There was a soft feeling under Chu Mo's feet, like stepping on cotton, which became hard again with a slight exertion.Some wonders.
Lingyun carried everyone through the many immortal peaks, and after about a stick of incense, they landed on a huge pavilion hidden among ancient trees.
The entire pavilion is made of a dark-colored spiritual wood, with cornices and corners, making it majestic. There is a huge plaque hanging on the lintel, with three characters written on it - Sutra Pavilion.
Jiang Yunya fell first, and Lingyun then shrunk and slipped back into his sleeve. He led the nine disciples into the gate and shouted to the old man behind the entrance desk:
